Complete Guide to Safety, DRO, MPG, Probing, EtherCAT, and Metrological Calibration
Search manual (e.g., calibration, alarm, MPG, WCS, E-STOP)…
Machine states, permitted controls during machining, and alarm recovery.

The LinuxCNC Droid HMI architecture implements industrial interlocks according to ISO 23125:

• RUNNING STATE (Cycle in progress):
 – Active: Emergency Stop (E–STOP), Feed Hold (Immediate pause), Abort/Stop, Feed Overrides (0–150%%) and Spindle (50–120%%), Coolant.
 - Blocked: Manual Jog (buttons and MPG dial), Zeroing (G92), Homing (G28), MDI, and configuration changes.

• ALARM MANAGEMENT & RECOVERY:
 - When a fault is triggered (servo overload, limit switch, thermal limit), the path planner stops in <1ms and preserves the active G-Code line.
 - To resume:
 1. Physically clear the cause.
 2. In the LOGS tab, press 'CLEAR LOGS / RESET'.
 3. Press 'POWER ON'.
 4. Press 'CYCLE START' to continue from the line where the fault occurred.

string-array.name: manual_sec1_sop
string-array.item: In case of imminent collision, press the red E-STOP button in the top bar.
To correct vibration (chatter), adjust the Spindle Override slider up or Feed Override down without stopping the program.
After an alarm stop, check the error code in the LOGS tab before re-energizing.

string-array.name: manual_sec1_safety
string-array.item: Never attempt to move axes manually while the cycle is running.
Verify that the external physical emergency stop is in series with the safety relay in the electrical cabinet.

resources.string: Calibration standard every 10% of the axis, uncertainty calculation, and leadscrew compensation (comp.tbl).

The metrological assistant allows evaluating and correcting ballscrew pitch error (Pitch Error Mapping) according to ISO 230–2:

• 10%%%% SECTOR METHOD:
 The total axis travel is divided into 10 intervals (0%%, 10%%, 20%%, …, 100%%).
 At each point, the operator takes a reading with their master instrument (micrometer, dial indicator, optical scale).

• COMBINED UNCERTAINTY CALCULATION (ISO/IEC 17025):
 Integrates the operator's instrument uncertainty (U_inst) with the axis repeatability.
 Calculates the Expanded Uncertainty U with a coverage factor k=2 (95%% confidence level).

• DIRECT APPLICATION IN LINUXCNC (comp.tbl):
 Upon completion, the system generates the 'comp.tbl' file for the 'linear_comp' HAL module. LinuxCNC will actively compensate for deviations in real-time during cutting.

string-array.name: manual_sec2_sop
string-array.item: Open the Metrological Calibration dialog from the top bar (ruler/compass icon).
Select the axis (X, Y, or Z), travel length, and declare your instrument\'s uncertainty (e.g., ±0.003 mm).
Press \'INIT SESSION\' to generate the 11 test points.
For each point, press \'DRIVE AXIS\' to position the head at the nominal coordinate.
Read the master instrument, enter the measured value, and press \'SAVE & NEXT\'.
At 100% completion, review the error curve and press \'EXPORT comp.tbl\' to copy the compensation table to your LinuxCNC configuration.

string-array.name: manual_sec2_safety
string-array.item: Ensure the spindle is at normal operating temperature (15 minutes of prior rotation) to avoid thermal drift during measurement.
Fix the dial indicator firmly to the bed with a rigid magnetic base.

resources.string: DRO digital readout, WCS G54-G59 work origin, G53 machine coordinates, and servo torque.

The DRO panel displays real-time positions with 3-decimal resolution (0.001 mm):

• COORDINATE MODES:
 - WORK POS (G54 to G59): Coordinates relative to the workpiece origin.
 - MACHINE ABS (G53): Physical absolute coordinates of the frame relative to the Home limit switches.
 - DISTANCE TO GO (DTG): Remaining distance to the end of the current G-Code block.

• SERVO TELEMETRY:
 Monitors the percentage load of the servo drive (%% Torque). Sustained values above 85%% indicate guide wear or excessive feed rate.

string-array.name: manual_sec3_sop
string-array.item: Select the desired work system from the top bar selector (G54 by default).
To zero an individual axis, use the axis ZERO button in the DRO panel.
To reference all axes to the physical limit switches, press \'HOME ALL (G28)\'.

string-array.name: manual_sec3_safety
string-array.item: Never zero G92 coordinates with the cutter inside the material without verifying safety heights.

resources.string: Industrial 100-division touch handwheel with x1, x10, x100, x1000 resolution multipliers.

The virtual MPG handwheel faithfully emulates a physical electronic handwheel (Handwheel MPG):

• 100 DIVISIONS PER REVOLUCIÓN (3.6° per tactile detent).
• MULTIPLIERS:
 - x1: 0.001 mm / step (Final micrometric alignment).
 - x10: 0.010 mm / step (Precision approach).
 - x100: 0.100 mm / step (Fast workpiece positioning).
 - x1000: 1.000 mm / step (Long table travel).
• HAPTIC FEEDBACK: Emits a vibration and acoustic click at each 3.6° notch.

string-array.name: manual_sec4_sop
string-array.item: In the Jog panel, select the \'VIRTUAL MPG WHEEL\' tab.
Choose the axis to move (X, Y, Z, or A) in the axis selector.
Select the appropriate multiplier (start with x10 for safety).
Turn the handle with your finger clockwise (+) or counter-clockwise (-) while observing the DRO response.

string-array.name: manual_sec4_safety
string-array.item: On the Z-axis near the vise or workpiece, use exclusively x1 or x10 multipliers to avoid spindle collisions.

resources.string: Management of T1-T99 cutters, H length compensation (G43), fast Touch-Off, and tool life.

The tool manager synchronizes directly with the LinuxCNC 'tool.tbl' file:

• MOUNT TOOL (M6): Loads the tool into the spindle and activates G43 Hx compensation.
• TOUCH-OFF Z (G43.1): Allows calibrating the current tool length by taking the spindle Z coordinate with a single touch.
• WEAR MONITORING: Alerts when accumulated cutting time exceeds 85%% of estimated tool life.

string-array.name: manual_sec5_sop
string-array.item: Open the Tool Table from the wrench icon in the top bar.
To mount a tool, locate the desired slot and press \'MOUNT (M6)\'.
To calibrate its Z length, lower the tip until it touches the table sensor and press \'TOUCH-OFF (G43.1)\'.

string-array.name: manual_sec5_safety
string-array.item: Verify that the maximum RPM assigned to the tool does not exceed the capacity of the collet or toolholder.

resources.string: Automated routines for centering holes, cylinders, corners, and Z-height sensing.

The PROBING tab includes kinematic routines with electrical contact stop (G38.2):

• BORE CENTER: Probes in 4 quadrants (-X, +X, -Y, +Y) and calculates the exact hole center.
• BOSS CENTER: Probes the 4 external faces of a cylinder to find the center axis.
• CORNER FINDER: Locates the XY vertex of a corner to set the workpiece origin.
• SURFACE HEIGHT Z: Descends until contact to set the Z=0 plane.

string-array.name: manual_sec6_sop
string-array.item: Mount the 3D probe and connect the signal cable to the PROBE port.
Position the probe manually inside the hole or over the surface.
In the PROBING tab, press the desired routine (e.g., BORE CENTER).
The system will execute the contacts and automatically update WCS G54.

string-array.name: manual_sec6_safety
string-array.item: Test the probe indicator LED by gently touching it with your hand before starting an automatic cycle.

resources.string: Real-time monitoring of CiA402 slaves, cycle jitter, and lost frames.

The EtherCAT monitor reports the health of the industrial automation network:

• MASTER STATE: Must remain in OP (Operational).
• CYCLE JITTER: Real-time clock time variation. Values < 5 µs are optimal.
• LOST FRAMES: If this counter rises above 0, check shielded cabling and grounding.

string-array.name: manual_sec7_sop
string-array.item: Access the ETHERCAT tab.
Verify that all servo drives for X, Y, Z axes appear in \'OP\' state.
Monitor drive temperatures during heavy machining work.

string-array.name: manual_sec7_safety
string-array.item: If the master enters INIT or PRE-OP state during machining, the machine will execute an instantaneous safety stop.
